history.q: Under BCBS-IOSCO what haircut applies to main index equities?
history.a: **Regulatory haircut** (equity_main_index, AAA-AA-, 1-5y): 15.0% (+8.0% if currency mismatch). Source: BCBS-IOSCO standardised haircut schedule (Appendix B).
